label: Trudeau playing both sides between Trump and Macron
description: Seen in prayer on 10 November 2024: the Canadian prime minister described as two-faced, publicly presenting himself as an ally of the United States and a friend of Trump while actually serving Macron's agenda and a European coalition.

label: The honey glow and white suits in the tents
description: A recurring image of tent meetings in which those ministering wear white suits, white shoes and white ties and carry a honey glow, offered later as protection against bird flu, swine flu and other illness.
